content.title: Routine Pre-Chemo Complete Blood Count & Renal Panel
content.rawText: Hb: 11.4 g/dL, WBC: 4,800/uL, Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC): 2,450/uL, Platelets: 185,000/uL. Serum Creatinine: 0.82 mg/dL, SGOT: 28 U/L, SGPT: 31 U/L. Bone marrow and organ functions adequate for systemic cytotoxic therapy.

sections.clinicalSummary: Hematology & Biochemistry satisfactory. ANC 2,450/uL, cleared for cytotoxic infusion.
